info.name: HustleHub+ API – Part 2
info.description:
Postman collection for HustleHub+ Part 2 – Secure Stack.

Run the folders in order (or the whole collection with Newman: `npm run test:api` in /backend).
Every run registers fresh users using a timestamp, so it can be re-run against the same database.

Covers success and failure cases for: authentication, protected routes, gig management with
ownership checks, bookings/transactions, income tracking, admin RBAC, input validation,
XSS escaping, NoSQL injection and security headers.

Variables: {{baseUrl}} (environment), {{adminEmail}} / {{adminPassword}} (environment or
--env-var), tokens and ids are set automatically by the test scripts.

Note: the auth routes allow 20 requests per 15 minutes per IP. A full run uses 12, so restart
the API (or wait 15 minutes) before running the collection a second time.

exec: pm.test('Same generic message (no user enumeration)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Invalid email or password.'));
pm.test('Error message is meaningful', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/invalid authentication token/i));
pm.test('Gig has an id and price', () => { const g = pm.response.json().gig; pm.expect(g.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(g.price).to.eql(1500); });

item.name: Create Gig – XSS Payload Is Escaped (201)
Create Gig – HTML In Title Rejected (422)
Create Gig – Category Not In List (422)

exec: pm.test('Freelancer shown by name only', () => { const g = pm.response.json().gigs[0]; pm.expect(g.freelancer).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(g.freelancer).to.not.have.property('email'); });
pm.test('Price and title updated', () => { const g = pm.response.json().gig; pm.expect(g.price).to.eql(1800); pm.expect(g.title).to.eql('Premium Logo Design'); });
pm.test('Error message is meaningful', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/your own gigs/i));
pm.test('Amount is the client\'s own offer', () => pm.expect(tx.amount).to.eql(1500));

pm.test('Linked to gig, client and freelancer', () => { pm.expect(tx.gig).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('gigId')); pm.expect(tx.client).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(tx.freelancer).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('Client sees their pending request', () => { const t = pm.response.json().transactions; pm.expect(t).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(t[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('transactionId')); pm.expect(t[0].status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(t[0].freelancer.name).to.eql('Bob Nkosi'); });

pm.test('Freelancer sees request with details', () => { const t = pm.response.json().transactions; pm.expect(t).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(t[0].client.name).to.eql('Alice Dlamini'); pm.expect(t[0].details).to.include('coffee cart'); });

item.name: My Requests – Other Freelancer Sees None (200)

exec: pm.test('No access to other freelancers\' requests', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().count).to.eql(0));
pm.test('No income until the request is accepted', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().totalIncome).to.eql(0); pm.expect(pm.response.json().bookings).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('Ownership enforced', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/only respond to requests sent to you/));
pm.test('Acceptance counts as simulated payment', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/payment simulated/i));
pm.test('A request can only be answered once', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/already been accepted/));
pm.test('Accepted offer counted as income', () => { pm.expect(s.totalIncome).to.eql(1500); pm.expect(s.bookings).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Request Record Kept After Gig Deletion (200)

exec: pm.test('Request history preserved', () => { const t = pm.response.json().transactions[0]; pm.expect(t.gigTitle).to.eql('Premium Logo Design'); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('accepted'); });
